Package io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator

Class EMFConfigurableFeatureSetter<T1 extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EStructuralFeature,T2 extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EStructuralFeature,V>

java.lang.Object
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFConfigurableFeatureSetter<T1,T2,V>
Type Parameters:
T1 - The type of EStructuralFeature (e.g., EAttribute, EReference) used for setting.
T2 - The type of EStructuralFeature (e.g., EAttribute, EReference) used for creating the feature value.
V - The type of value returned for the feature
Direct Known Subclasses:
EMFAttributeSetter, EMFCrossReferenceSetter, EMFInstanceCreatorFeatureSetter
public abstract class EMFConfigurableFeatureSetter<T1 extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EStructuralFeature,T2 extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EStructuralFeature,V> extends Object
Base class for setting configurable features on EMF EObjects. Supports setting maximum counts for multi-valued features and associating operations with features.

    • setDefaultMaxCount

      public void setDefaultMaxCount(int defaultMaxCount)
      Set the default maximum count of values to generate for multi-valued features. Used when no specific count has been configured for a feature via setMaxCountFor(EStructuralFeature, int).
      Parameters:
      defaultMaxCount - the default maximum count

    • shouldSetFeature

      protected boolean shouldSetFeature(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject owner, T1 feature)
      Determines whether the feature should be set on the given owner EObject. By default, the feature should be set if it is not already set.
      Parameters:
      owner - the owner EObject
      feature - the feature to check
      Returns:
      true if the feature should be set, false otherwise

    • setFeature

      public void setFeature(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject owner, T1 feature)
      Template method to set the feature on the given owner EObject. It checks whether the feature should be set, and delegates to the appropriate method for single-valued (setSingleFeature(EObject, EStructuralFeature)) or multi-valued features (setMultiFeature(EObject, EStructuralFeature)).
      Parameters:
      owner - the EObject on which to set the feature
      feature - the feature to set
